description: This PHP class 'TimeConfigPeriodModel' serves as a model representing a time configuration period. It implements the 'Normalizable' interface which indicates it can be converted into an array, likely for serialization or API responses. The class encapsulates a 'TimeConfigPeriod' data object and provides a method to output its 'startDay' property as part of an array.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriodModel
classes.description: A model class that encapsulates a TimeConfigPeriod object and provides array serialization.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a TimeConfigPeriod object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model to an associative array, exposing the 'startDay' property.
